_readme: Drake 99M screen setup. field_order = Tab order on the screen (use __SKIP__ to tab past a field). The default order is a starting point, NOT yet confirmed on a real Drake screen: run 'python run.py calibrate --form 99M' on a TEST return and fix it before real use. Fields not listed here are kept in the input workbook for reference but never typed. field_ids/focus_check are written by: python run.py map-fields --form 99M. keys overrides settings.json keys for this screen only.
